Q.QUESTION: What is the current core gameplay loop? Identify actual implemented loop. Compare against intended Paradox Pay loop. List gaps.
Q.R:
IMPLEMENTED_LOOP: 1. CLIENT sends CREATE_ROOM → GameRoom constructor: CSPRNG(nanoid(32)), SixPoolManager(playerCount,csprng), createGrid(dim,settings,pool), SHA256(seed) committed. 2. CLIENT sends JOIN_ROOM → addPlayer(ws,playerId,playerName,classArchetype='Paladin'). 3. CLIENT sends START_GAME → handleStartGame(): energy tick interval 200ms, turn timer set, MATCH_START event emitted. 4. CLIENT sends SUBMIT_CHAIN(positions[]) → processChain(): a. Extract faces from grid positions. b. scoreFarkle(faces, multiplierQ) → {score, scaledScore, isFarkle, combo, triggersBomb}. c. FARKLE PATH: unbanked=0, farklePool+=unbanked_before, multiplierStep=0, phase=FARKLE_ANIM, nextTurn(). d. SCORE PATH (chain.length lt 6): scaledScore added to unbanked, auto-bank (unbanked→banked), multiplierStep=0, gravity+spawn. e. SCORE PATH (chain.length=6): scaledScore added to unbanked, multiplierStep++, timer restart, NO auto-bank. f. triggersBomb=BOMB_STANDARD → applyStandardBomb(3×3). triggersBomb=BOMB_RAINBOW → applyRainbowBomb(most-common-face). g. Every 5 bankCycleCount increments: applyGravityFlip(grid). 5. CLIENT sends BANK → handleBank(): unbanked→banked, multiplierStep=0, win-check (banked≥levelWinScore). 6. Win: endSession() → SESSION_END broadcast with seed reveal, payout computed per mode.
PARADOX_PAY_LOOP_AS_SPECIFIED: NOT DEFINED in codebase. No file, type, mode, or function uses the string "Paradox Pay" or "paradox_pay". The brand name exists only as the directive id PARADOX_PAY_QNA0.
INFERRED_PARADOX_PAY_INTENT (from game vision docs F9, F8): - Skill-reads spatial board → informs Farkle risk → player decision to chain or bank. - Provably fair RNG → sweepstakes PDX payout → verifiable by player post-session. - Progressive value systems competing simultaneously (score + currency + social + progression). - PvP (VS), co-op (RALLY), betrayal (HEIST) on same Sacred Core.
GAPS_BETWEEN_IMPLEMENTED_AND_VISION: G1: No lobby classArchetype selection UI — defaults to 'Paladin' (T9 L0 flag, F7:111). G2: spawnTiles has zero board-state awareness — cascades are physics-only, no opportunity shaping (F3:335-364, F15). G3: dead-state detection (hasValidChain F3:515-543) has no implemented reshuffle recovery in gameRoom.ts; unclear what gameRoom does when hasValidChain returns false. G4: DRAFT phase (facet selection, F8:121-126) not wired in gameRoom.ts; newmodespec.md specifies it but implementation shows no DRAFT message type. G5: 20 genre modules specified in F8 but implementation in gameRoom.ts imports only: eventHorizon, comboBreaker, slipstream, facet, shard, rhythm, gravityFlip, flowMultiplier. Remainder (Horror, Metroidvania, Battle Royale, Sandbox, MOBA) not wired. G6: HollaEx PDX on-ramp not implemented (design/02-hollaex-integration.md, ADR-022 pending). G7: Lobby JOIN_ROOM message does not carry classArchetype field. G8: Session analytics (chain_decisions, skill_score) written only in casino modes; free modes produce no audit trail.
Q.RISK: HIGH — gap G3 (dead-state recovery) could cause game freeze in production; G4 (DRAFT) means genre system is largely unimplemented despite spec.
Q.MISSING: - Exact gameRoom.ts handling of hasValidChain=false (need lines 250+). - Whether DRAFT phase was intentionally deferred or accidentally omitted. - Whether all 20 genres in F8 are committed scope or speculative.

Q.QUESTION: What currently controls: tile spawning, blocker spawning, creature spawning, bomb spawning, wild spawning, board generation, cascade generation.
Q.R:
TILE_SPAWNING: Controller: F3:spawnTiles(grid,pool) lines 335-364. Mechanism: For each col c where grid[0][c].state=EMPTY → pool.drawWild() → if w===3 makeWildCell else pool.drawDie() → makeDieCell(face). Board state inputs: NONE. spawnTiles has no grid scan, no cascade analysis, no score awareness. Pool: SixPoolManager.drawDie() → pre-shuffled dieLive pool (equal face distribution, perFace = diePoolSize/6). Pool is seeded at room creation, not per-spawn.
BLOCKER_SPAWNING: Controller: F3:createGrid(size,settings,pool,seedNum) lines 230-291. Mechanism: seededRng(seedNum), blockerCount from BLOCKER_DENSITY_RANGES[settings.blockerDensity] {LOW:3-4, MEDIUM:5-7, HIGH:8-12}, stoneCount=floor(blockerCount/2), iceCount=floor(blockerCount/4), lockCount=remainder. Stone placement: _clusterPlace(candidates, stoneCount, rng) — 70% biased adjacency (vein formation). Ice placement: random from shuffled candidate pool. Lock placement: random from remaining candidate pool. Called once at game start. Blockers do NOT respawn mid-game. Board state inputs: NONE beyond initial density setting.
CREATURE_SPAWNING: NONE. No creature system exists in implemented code. ghost tile (F1:27) drifts but is a tile, not a creature. No creature type, no creature spawn function, no creature ability system implemented.
BOMB_SPAWNING: Controller: F2:41-45 (scoreFarkle trigger detection). Mechanism: BOMB_STANDARD triggered when combo==='Six of a Kind' AND faces.length===6. BOMB_RAINBOW triggered when combo==='Straight' AND faces.length===6. Both triggered deterministically by scoring — NOT dynamically spawned. Applied: F3:applyStandardBomb, F3:applyRainbowBomb called from gameRoom.ts processChain. Spawn: bombs do NOT appear on board as tiles via spawnTiles. They are board states set by game logic (BOMB_FUSE phase).
WILD_SPAWNING: Controller: F3:SixPoolManager.drawWild() lines 135-148. Pool composition: wildLive initialized as: r<0.60→type0(blank), r<0.75→type1, r<0.90→type2, else type3(true-wild). Pool size=ceil(dim*dim/4). True-wild probability: ~10% of wild draws (type3 only triggers makeWildCell at w===3 in spawnTiles). Effective wild spawn rate on board: ~10% of non-blocker fill positions at creation/refill. Board state inputs: NONE. wildLive pool is pre-built, static distribution, no stagnation response. Catalyst modifier: CATALYST_WILD_BOOST=2% per committed catalyst, CATALYST_MAX_BOOST=10% (F1:76-77). Not wired to wildLive pool probability — implementation unclear.
BOARD_GENERATION: Controller: F3:createGrid lines 230-291. Inputs: size (from multiplayerGridSize), settings.blockerDensity, SixPoolManager, seedNum=Date.now(). Note: seedNum=Date.now() is NOT deterministic — different from CSPRNG seed. This means grid layout differs per wall-clock, not per CSPRNG. POTENTIAL FAIRNESS GAP. Grid fill: each non-blocker cell → drawWild() → w===3: makeWildCell(drawDie()), else: makeDieCell(drawDie()).
CASCADE_GENERATION: Controller: F3:stepGravity(grid) lines 295-318. Mechanism: Pure downward physics. For each cell (top to bottom): if canFall AND cell below is EMPTY → swap. canFall = state=WILD OR type=ICE OR (state=NORMAL AND isDieTile). Dynamic cascade: NONE. No intentional combo-chain generation. No board analysis to plan cascades. Board state inputs: NONE beyond gravity physics. Dead-state check: F3:hasValidChain(grid) — BFS across all chainable tiles checking if any 2+ path scores gt 0. Called externally; no internal recovery trigger in F3.
Q.RISK: MEDIUM — seedNum=Date.now() in createGrid breaks deterministic replay; CSPRNG seed covers RNG but not grid layout seed.
Q.MISSING: - Where gameRoom.ts calls hasValidChain and what it does on false (lines 250+ not read). - Catalyst wild boost wiring — types.ts defines it, unclear if spawnTiles uses it.

Q.QUESTION: What are all current tile types? Full inventory. Purpose. Value contribution. Retention contribution.
Q.R:
T01: die (DieColor: RED/ORANGE/YELLOW/GREEN/BLUE/PURPLE = faces 1-6) PURPOSE: Core scoring tile. Face determines scoring value. VALUE: Face1=100pts solo, Face5=50pts solo; combos (Three-of-a-kind N×100, Straight=1500, etc). RETENTION: Primary skill expression. Board reading skill derives from face distribution. COMPONENT_AUDIT_SCORE: 0.85 (S-tier, F16).
T02: sphere (green NRG orb) PURPOSE: Energy resource. Tap removes tile, grants +8 energy (GAME_CONSTANTS). VALUE: Zero scoring value. Energy gate transition value only. RETENTION: Enables PRIME→FRENZY transitions. Strategic in energy management. SPAWN_WEIGHT: NORMAL=25%, PRIME=18%, FRENZY=12%. COMPONENT_AUDIT_SCORE: 0.61 (A-tier, F16, listed as Sphere).
T03: ice (FROZEN state) PURPOSE: Blocker. Unchainable. Thaws to die on adjacent commit. Bomb-destructible. VALUE: Zero direct score. Indirectly scores when thawed and subsequently chained. RETENTION: Creates planning horizon (thaw mechanic). Good chain planning. SPAWN_WEIGHT: NORMAL=1%, PRIME=6%, FRENZY=6%. COMPONENT_AUDIT_SCORE: 0.66 (A-tier, F16).
T04: lock (LOCKED state, health 1-3) PURPOSE: Blocker. Must be included in scoring chain to damage. Reduces to die at 0HP. VALUE: Must appear in chain — forces chain constraint choices. RETENTION: Decision pressure. Low cascade contribution. SPAWN_WEIGHT: NORMAL=0%, PRIME=3%, FRENZY=4%. COMPONENT_AUDIT_SCORE: 0.49 (B-tier, F16). Recommended: hidden-face variant.
T05: wild (WILD state, face=underlying_value) PURPOSE: Scoring optimizer. Adopts optimal face at commit (exhaustive 6^n search in _resolveWilds). VALUE: Always chooses max-scoring face combination. Dramatically lowers Farkle risk. RETENTION: Strategic board reading — wild density visible. High anticipation. SPAWN_WEIGHT: NORMAL=0%, PRIME=2%, FRENZY=9%. SPAWN_TRIGGER: pool.drawWild() type3 (10% of wild draws, ~10% non-blocker cells). COMPONENT_AUDIT_SCORE: 0.82 (S-tier, F16).
T06: bomb / BOMB_STANDARD PURPOSE: Area clear. 3×3 blast centered on bomb tile. Triggered by Six-of-a-Kind combo. VALUE: ptsEarned=25 (self) + blast hits: face1=100, face5=50, others=0, stone=50, lock=50. RETENTION: Satisfying clear. Feels random not earned (not spawned dynamically). SPAWN_WEIGHT: PRIME=1%, FRENZY=7%. Also triggered by scoring (farkleScorer). COMPONENT_AUDIT_SCORE: 0.73 (A-tier, BOMB_STANDARD, F16).
T07: rainbow_bomb / BOMB_RAINBOW PURPOSE: Board-wide color clear. Triggered by Straight combo (1-2-3-4-5-6). VALUE: Clears all tiles of most common face. Configurable per-face reward (rainbowRedReward, rainbowBlueReward). RETENTION: Requires board reading (Straight is spatial). High anticipation. SPAWN_WEIGHT: FRENZY=1% only. COMPONENT_AUDIT_SCORE: 0.78 (A-tier, BOMB_RAINBOW, F16).
T08: mirror PURPOSE: Face = opposite of chain neighbor (MIRROR_OPPOSITES: 1↔6, 2↔5, 3↔4). VALUE: Scoring contribution depends on placement relative to chain. RETENTION: Situational. Low cascade contribution. Weak mechanic. SPAWN_WEIGHT: NORMAL=4%, PRIME=6%, FRENZY=7%. COMPONENT_AUDIT_SCORE: 0.49 (B-tier, F16). Recommended: clarify or merge into wild.
T09: stone (STONE type, health=1-2 per makeStoneCell rng) PURPOSE: Persistent blocker. Unchainable. Bomb or adjacent-chain damage only. NOTE: GAME_CONSTANTS.STONE_HP=2 but makeStoneCell uses rng→Math.floor(rng()*maxHp)+1 → hp 1 or 2. VALUE: 50pts on destroy (BOMB_STONE_PTS). Does NOT drop bioSteel in current implementation (types.ts mentions it, no code found). RETENTION: Time consumption gt decision creation. Frustration risk. SPAWN_WEIGHT: NORMAL=4%, PRIME=5%, FRENZY=5%. COMPONENT_AUDIT_SCORE: 0.51 (B-tier, F16). Recommended: weakness-face mechanic.
T10: multiplier_orb (blue-gold sphere) PURPOSE: Tactical bonus. Tap grants next commit ×1.5. Single use. VALUE: Multiplies next chain's scaledScore by 1.5. RETENTION: Creates anticipation window. Timing decisions. SPAWN_WEIGHT: NORMAL=3%, PRIME=4%, FRENZY=5%. COMPONENT_AUDIT_SCORE: 0.64 (A-tier, F16). Recommended: 3-turn commitment window.
T11: ghost PURPOSE: Ignores column constraint. Drifts. Tap to anchor → becomes die. VALUE: Unclear mechanical purpose. No column constraint is rarely relevant. RETENTION: Mechanic confusion. Lowest ValueScore. SPAWN_WEIGHT: NORMAL=1%, PRIME=2%, FRENZY=3%. COMPONENT_AUDIT_SCORE: 0.42 (C-tier, F16). Recommended: redesign to Echo tile.
T12: catalyst PURPOSE: Committed in chain → +2% wild spawn weight (max +10% total, CATALYST_WILD_BOOST=2, CATALYST_MAX_BOOST=10). VALUE: Cumulative wild spawn boost. Strategic investment. RETENTION: Long-term board shaping. Good skill expression. SPAWN_WEIGHT: NORMAL=0%, PRIME=1%, FRENZY=2%. BOMB_PTS: 40 (BOMB_CONSTANTS.CATALYST_PTS). COMPONENT_AUDIT_SCORE: 0.64 (A-tier, F16). NOTE: Wiring between catalyst commit and actual wildLive pool probability not confirmed in spawnTiles code.
Q.RISK: LOW — inventory complete from types.ts EntityType enum and SPAWN_WEIGHTS. Ghost/catalyst wiring uncertainty is medium risk.
Q.MISSING: - Catalyst wild boost wiring in spawnTiles (only drawWild() w===3 threshold, no CATALYST_MAX_BOOST applied). - bioSteel mechanic from stone destroy (mentioned in types.ts comment, no implementation found).

Q.QUESTION: All current blockers. Inventory. Frequency. Function. Frustration score. Decision score. Removal recommendation.
Q.R:
B01: STONE FREQUENCY: MEDIUM density: 2-3 tiles; HIGH: 4-6 tiles. Clustered (70% adjacency bias). Spawned at game start only. FUNCTION: Unchainable. Takes 1-2 bomb hits or adjacent chain damage (damageAdjacentBlockers, F3:452-481) to destroy. HEADHUNTER role doubles damage. FRUSTRATION_SCORE: HIGH (4/5). Blocks chain paths without providing decisions. Consumes turns via adjacent-damage attrition. DECISION_SCORE: LOW (1/5). Player decides to chain adjacent but this is rarely meaningful — any adjacent chain triggers damage. REMOVAL_RECOMMENDATION: Keep but add weakness-face mechanic (COMPONENT_AUDIT priority 7). STONE gets a hidden face; chain that face → 2× damage. Creates board reading value. COMPONENT_AUDIT_SCORE: 0.51 (B-tier, F16).
B02: ICE FREQUENCY: MEDIUM: 1-1 tile (floor(blockerCount/4)); LOW: 0-1. Randomly placed. FUNCTION: Frozen die — face visible, unchainable. Adjacent commit (any direction) thaws to normal die. Bomb destroys immediately. FRUSTRATION_SCORE: LOW (2/5). Thaw mechanic is clear. Player can plan around it. DECISION_SCORE: HIGH (4/5). Creates chain planning (thaw sequence, bomb targeting). REMOVAL_RECOMMENDATION: Keep. Highest blocker ValueScore. No change needed. COMPONENT_AUDIT_SCORE: 0.66 (A-tier, F16).
B03: LOCK FREQUENCY: MEDIUM: 1-2 tiles (remainder of blockerCount after stone+ice). Randomly placed. FUNCTION: Shows face, health 1-3. Must be INCLUDED in a scoring chain to take damage. 0HP → becomes normal die. FRUSTRATION_SCORE: MEDIUM-HIGH (3/5). Mandatory chain inclusion can block optimal plays. DECISION_SCORE: MEDIUM (3/5). Forces inclusion decision. Currently hidden-face variant absent. REMOVAL_RECOMMENDATION: Add hidden-face variant — face revealed only when chain attempts include it. Increases decision value. COMPONENT_AUDIT_SCORE: 0.49 (B-tier, F16).
BLOCKER_DENSITY_TABLE: LOW: blockerCount 3-4 → stone 1-2, ice 0-1, lock 1. MEDIUM: blockerCount 5-7 → stone 2-3, ice 1, lock 1-3. HIGH: blockerCount 8-12 → stone 4-6, ice 2-3, lock 2-4. NOTE: BLOCKER_DENSITY_COUNTS in SixPoolManager constructor hardcodes MEDIUM=6 (F3:72) regardless of lobby setting — potential bug.
Q.RISK: MEDIUM — BLOCKER_DENSITY_COUNTS=6 hardcoded in SixPoolManager constructor despite LobbySettings.blockerDensity being configurable. SixPoolManager does not use density for pool sizing.
Q.MISSING: - Whether HEADHUNTER role (damageAdjacentBlockers isHeadhunter=true) is fully implemented in gameRoom.ts role assignment. - Lock health random range (makeStoneCell uses rng for stone, makeLockCell does not — lock always max HP 1-3 from type?).

Q.QUESTION: All current bombs. Inventory. Trigger conditions. Counterplay. Strategic depth. Replacement recommendations.
Q.R:
BOM01: BOMB_STANDARD TRIGGER: scoreFarkle returns combo='Six of a Kind' AND faces.length===6 (F2:43). MECHANISM: applyStandardBomb(grid, bombRow, bombCol, isHeadhunter) F3:380-419. Radius: BOMB_RADIUS=1 (3×3 grid area). Each cell in blast: STONE: damage 1 (or 2 if HEADHUNTER), destroy if hp≤0 (+50pts). ICE/FROZEN: → EMPTY immediately. BOMB_STANDARD/BOMB_RAINBOW: → EMPTY (chain detonation possible). Die face1: +100pts. Die face5: +50pts. Other die faces: +0pts. LOCKED cells: skip (state=LOCKED, F3:398). ptsEarned starts at 25 (BOMB_CONSTANTS.SELF_PTS). COUNTERPLAY: NONE — once Six-of-a-Kind is formed the bomb fires. Player cannot cancel. STRATEGIC_DEPTH: LOW-MEDIUM. Chain positioning matters (target stone clusters). But trigger requires rare 6-of-a-kind. COMPONENT_AUDIT_SCORE: 0.73. Deduction: feels random not earned. REPLACEMENT_RECOMMENDATION: Add pre-trigger indicator: when 4/6 dice in chain match, show blast preview overlay. Increases strategic depth without changing mechanic.
BOM02: BOMB_RAINBOW TRIGGER: scoreFarkle returns combo='Straight' AND faces.length===6 (F2:44). Straight = all 6 faces (1,2,3,4,5,6) present. MECHANISM: applyRainbowBomb(grid, targetColor, multiplier, rainbowRedReward, rainbowBlueReward) F3:421-448. targetColor = most common die face color on board. Clears ALL tiles of that color (entire board scan). Locked cells skipped. Points: targetColor=RED → +rainbowRedReward×multiplier per tile. targetColor=BLUE → +rainbowBlueReward×multiplier. Other colors → +0pts. COUNTERPLAY: Indirect — player can influence most-common-face by chaining to reduce density, shifting which color rainbow targets. STRATEGIC_DEPTH: HIGH. Requires board reading: Straight combo + targetColor selection. Best in class. COMPONENT_AUDIT_SCORE: 0.78. Highest bomb score. REPLACEMENT_RECOMMENDATION: Add "Straight in progress" indicator (5/6 chain approaching Straight). Increases mastery expression.
NOTE: Bombs cannot be spawned mid-game by any non-scoring path. PRIME/FRENZY spawn weights include 'bomb' and 'rainbow_bomb' (F1:48-49) but this refers to tile types that appear on board as fuse-state entities — the mechanism for transitioning them into BOMB_FUSE phase was not confirmed in read code. POTENTIAL AMBIGUITY.
Q.RISK: MEDIUM — bomb spawn via SPAWN_WEIGHTS (not scoring trigger) mechanism not confirmed in read code. If PRIME/FRENZY bomb weights spawn fused tiles directly, bomb frequency is higher than scoring-trigger-only path implies.
Q.MISSING: - Whether SPAWN_WEIGHTS bomb weight causes direct tile spawns (BOMB_FUSE phase) or is vestigial. - Cascade detonation logic (if one bomb blast hits another bomb, does chain detonate?).

Q.QUESTION: All current wild systems. Inventory. Trigger conditions. Frequency. Strategic value. Redesign opportunities.
Q.R:
W01: Wild tile (WILD state) SOURCE: SixPoolManager.drawWild() type3 (w===3). Probability ~10% of draws. POOL: wildLive built at init: 60% type0, 15% type1, 15% type2, 10% type3. Pre-shuffled. SPAWN_CONDITION: spawnTiles checks pool.drawWild()===3 → makeWildCell. Same in createGrid. RESOLUTION: _resolveWilds() in gridUtils.ts (F3:492-513). Exhaustive 6^n search over all wild positions. Selects face assignment maximizing lookupScore. Fully optimal — player has no input. FREQUENCY: NORMAL mode spawn weight=0% (SPAWN_WEIGHTS), PRIME=2%, FRENZY=9%. But SixPoolManager wild pool is always 10% type3 regardless of energy mode — SPAWN_WEIGHT wild field and SixPoolManager are INDEPENDENT systems. Possible architectural split: spawn weights may govern different spawn path than SixPoolManager pool. STRATEGIC_VALUE: HIGH. Eliminates Farkle risk for wild-heavy chains. Reduces need for board reading. REDESIGN: OWC wildBoostPct can push pool threshold from 3 to 2 (threshold = 3 - floor(wildBoostPct/3.3)) during stagnation. See F15.
W02: Wild Scatter (energy system) SOURCE: newmodespec.md (F8) mentions Wild Scatter as L2 energy gate mechanic: 3+ wilds simultaneously on board → force all players into FRENZY + destroy all tiles matching wilds' underlying face colors. IMPLEMENTATION: NOT CONFIRMED in read code. gameRoom.ts (F7:73) imports do not show a wildScatter function. scanForWilds() exists in F3:558-566 (counts wilds) but no scatter trigger visible in first 235 lines of F7. FREQUENCY: Unknown (tied to wild density). STRATEGIC_VALUE: HIGH if implemented. Game-changing board reset.
W03: Catalyst wild boost SOURCE: Catalyst tile committed in chain → +CATALYST_WILD_BOOST (2%) to wild spawn weight, max CATALYST_MAX_BOOST (10%). IMPLEMENTATION: F1:76-77 defines constants. spawnTiles (F3:348-349) only checks pool.drawWild()===3 — no boost applied to the 10% base probability. Wiring gap: catalyst effect on spawn probability not confirmed. FREQUENCY: Accumulates per committed catalyst (PRIME=1%, FRENZY=2% spawn weight). STRATEGIC_VALUE: SPECULATIVE — if wired, long-game board shaping. If not wired, dead mechanic.
Q.RISK: HIGH — Wild scatter (W02) and Catalyst boost (W03) may not be implemented despite being specified. If dead mechanics, removing them from UI docs is required before launch.
Q.MISSING: - scanForWilds threshold trigger in gameRoom.ts (lines 250+). - Catalyst boost application in spawnTiles or equivalent.

Q.QUESTION: What currently creates cascades? Static? Dynamic? Random? Controlled? Architecture.
Q.R:
CASCADE_TYPE: STATIC + RANDOM. No dynamic or controlled cascade generation.
STEP1_CHAIN_REMOVAL: processChain in gameRoom.ts removes scored tiles from grid (sets cells to EMPTY state). Bomb tiles also removed per applyStandardBomb/applyRainbowBomb.
STEP2_GRAVITY: stepGravity(grid) F3:295-318. Pure downward physics. Bottom-up iteration (r from rows-2 to 0). canFall tiles: WILD, ICE, or (NORMAL and isDieTile). Falls one row per call if cell below is EMPTY. Called in loop until hasEmptyBelow returns false.
STEP3_SPAWN: spawnTiles(grid,pool) F3:335-364. Fills top row (row 0) empty cells from SixPoolManager. Zero board-state awareness — draws next tile from pre-shuffled pool.
STEP4_DEADSTATE: hasValidChain(grid) F3:515-543. BFS from every chainable tile, checks if any 2+ length path has lookupScore>0. This is detection only — no recovery in F3.
RANDOMNESS_CHARACTERIZATION: - Tile faces: RANDOM but controlled distribution (pool = equal per-face distribution, pre-shuffled). - Tile type: RANDOM but controlled distribution (10% wild, 90% die from pool draws). - Cascade depth: RANDOM (depends on grid gaps created by chains — no planning). - Board dead state: RANDOM occurrence — no mechanism to guarantee productive refill.
MISSING_DYNAMIC_LAYER: OWC (F15) is the designed solution to add board-state awareness to spawn decisions. Currently F15 is design-only; implementation requires Human approval and ADR-021.
GRAVITY_FLIP: applyGravityFlip(grid) F3:578-590. Triggered every 5 bank cycles (bankCycleCount, F7:195). Reverses row order, applies 7-face complement to all die faces. RTP preserved (symmetric face distribution). Not a cascade mechanic — it's a board restructuring event.
Q.RISK: LOW — cascade architecture fully visible in read code.
Q.MISSING: - Whether gameRoom.ts calls hasValidChain and has a reshuffle path (lines 250+ not read). - cascadeMs=80 (GAME_CONSTANTS) — frame timing for cascade animation, confirmed in F1:177.

Q.QUESTION: What is current board dead-state frequency? Estimate. Measurement method. Evidence.
Q.R:
DEAD_STATE_DEFINED: hasValidChain(grid)=false — no 2+ tile chain exists that scores gt 0.
MEASUREMENT_METHOD_EXISTING: NONE. No telemetry for dead state events. analytics.ts (F14) logs chain_decisions and session data but no dead_state_event type. PostHog tracks session_start and level_complete but not board states.
ESTIMATE_METHOD: Inferred from spawn model. - 7×7 grid = 49 cells. MEDIUM density: ~6 blockers (stones cluster, ices random). ~43 chainable positions. - Die pool: equal face distribution (perFace = diePoolSize/6). After chains, refill from pool. - Dead state requires: no 2+ adjacent same-face pair AND no face1/face5 singletons. - With equal face distribution and grid size 7×7, probability of zero-1s AND zero-5s in entire 43-cell playfield is extremely low. - Dead state probability estimate: lt 1% per refill cycle under NORMAL conditions. - FRENZY mode: wild tiles (9%) reduce dead state risk further. - Stone clustering (Q5:B01) can create isolated regions — potential dead state if cluster splits board.
ESTIMATED_FREQUENCY: lt 0.5% of refill cycles. CONFIDENCE: 0.40 (no empirical data).
RECOVERY_MECHANISM: Unknown — hasValidChain is exported but recovery trigger in gameRoom.ts not confirmed in read code. Risk of game freeze if no recovery path.
Q.RISK: HIGH — no measurement and unknown recovery path. If dead state occurs and no reshuffle fires, game stalls. Regulatory issue if stall requires game exit.
Q.MISSING: - gameRoom.ts dead state handling (lines 250+). - Any PostHog event or analytics tracking for board dead states.

Q.QUESTION: Which mechanics create: meaningful decisions, non-meaningful decisions, fake choices, frustration loops.
Q.R:
MEANINGFUL_DECISIONS: M1: BANK vs CONTINUE (core Farkle). Unbanked at risk. Multiplier ladder. Board scan informs risk. M2: Chain selection (spatial). Which 2-6 tiles to connect — different faces → different scores → different Farkle risk. M3: Tile targeting for bombs. Position chain to maximize blast coverage on stone clusters. M4: HEIST trigger timing. Vault≥5000, HEIST_ENERGY_COST=50. Team blocks within 5s window. M5: Stealth Pocket — sacrifice chain slot to stash 1 die for later. Delayed gratification. M6: RALLY role selection — ARCHIVIST takes 15% tax on banked score for team benefit. Genuine sacrifice.
NON_MEANINGFUL_DECISIONS: NM1: Auto-bank on chain.length lt 6. Forced — no player choice. NM2: Turn timer forced bank. Forced — no player choice beyond time pressure. NM3: Wild face resolution — _resolveWilds() automatically picks optimal. Player cannot influence wild face selection. NM4: multiplier_orb tap. When to use it is trivially obvious (use before highest-score chain). Low strategic depth.
FAKE_CHOICES: FK1: Ghost tile anchor — ignores column constraint, but column constraint is rarely the limiting factor in chain building. Mechanic has near-zero strategic surface. FK2: Facet draft (ROGUELIKE DRAFT phase) — specified in F8 but NOT implemented in gameRoom.ts. Players may see UI elements for a system that has no effect. FK3: Energy management in NORMAL mode — energy only enters PRIME at 150. In NORMAL, sphere collection is binary (hit 150 or don't). No gradual strategy.
FRUSTRATION_LOOPS: FR1: STONE cluster. Adjacent chain required for damage, but chain may not score if forced to include non-scoring faces adjacent to stone. Player watches HP slowly drain with no satisfying payoff. FR2: LOCK in non-scoring column. Lock must be in chain, but if lock's column has no scoring neighbors, player is stuck. FR3: Farkle with full multiplier. Farkle resets multiplierStep=0. If achieved ×3.0 or ×4.0 and Farkle, loss magnitude feels disproportionate. FR4: Board dead state (if no recovery) — game becomes unplayable, no user feedback.
Q.RISK: MEDIUM — FK2 (unimplemented DRAFT phase) is a live UX debt if genre selection UI is visible.
Q.MISSING: Whether DRAFT phase has any UI or is fully server-side deferred.

Q.QUESTION: Which mechanics generate: mastery, anticipation, escalation, comeback moments, betrayal moments, social stories. Rank each.
Q.R:
MASTERY (skill ceiling): RANK1: Board reading for Farkle risk — distinguishing safe from risky chains. RANK2: Wild optimization — understanding which chain maximizes wild face resolution. RANK3: Bomb positioning — chain location to maximize 3×3 blast coverage. RANK4: Class ability timing (Rogue ×2 burst windows, Paladin shield use). RANK5: HEIST vault threshold management — staying under 5000 to control heist timing.
ANTICIPATION (tension before outcome): RANK1: BOMB_FUSE timer (bombFuseMs=3000ms) — 3 second countdown before blast. RANK2: Multiplier ladder advancement toward ×4.0 — 5th and 6th consecutive 6-chains. RANK3: HEARTBEAT phase (Horror) — 1 die remaining before Farkle, 300-600ms reveal delay. RANK4: HEIST_WINDOW_MS (5000ms) — vault threshold hit, waiting for team block. RANK5: Straight combo detection — building toward BOMB_RAINBOW requires all 6 faces.
ESCALATION (rising stakes): RANK1: Energy → PRIME → FRENZY transition. Simultaneous play + increased special density. RANK2: MULTIPLIER_LADDER [1.0→1.25→1.5→2.0→3.0→4.0]. Each 6-chain raises stakes. RANK3: RALLY_MILESTONES [10k→25k→50k→100k] with escalating multipliers [0.5→1.0→2.0→5.0]. RANK4: HEIST vault accumulation → threshold → heist resolution.
COMEBACK_MOMENTS: RANK1: Slipstream (F8:245-252) — trailing player gets wider beat window (1.5×), higher flow cap (2.0). Dynamic per round. RANK2: Farkle Pool recovery — farklePool accumulated from all farkling players; drainFarklePool returns points. RANK3: Paladin shield (RPG) — first Farkle absorbed. One-shot per match. RANK4: Combo Breaker token (Fighting) — reverse Farkle if token available. 250ms window.
BETRAYAL_MOMENTS: RANK1: HEIST mode — vault threshold triggers heist; teammates have 5s to block. Attacker vs defender tension. RANK2: HEIST vault split (70/30) — banking goes to vault, not personal score. Psychological loss of control. RANK3: RALLY CONDUCTOR role — can redirect team chains. Social power dynamic. RANK4: DisruptionEvent (ice_send, lock_send, scramble) — send blockers to opponent's board.
SOCIAL_STORIES: RANK1: HEIST block/success moment — 5-second real-time team vote → resolved publicly. RANK2: RALLY milestone bonuses — team achievement visible to all. RANK3: ReactionVote (UP/DOWN per player) — lightweight social signal per chain. RANK4: UserProfile.asciiArt + UsernameColor — identity expression in chat. RANK5: DisruptionEvent broadcasts — attack visible to all players.
Q.RISK: LOW — rankings are design judgments based on mechanics, not quantified retention data.
Q.MISSING: Actual session length and retention data. PostHog data would validate rankings empirically.

Q.QUESTION: Which systems currently resemble Buggin, Skydom, Farkle. Which do not?
Q.R:
FARKLE_RESEMBLANCE (HIGH): - scoreFarkle() exhaustive combo table: identical to traditional Farkle scoring (1s=100, 5s=50, Three-of-a-kind=N×100, Two-Triplets=2500, Straight=1500). - BANK vs CONTINUE risk decision: direct Farkle inheritance. - Farkle (zero-score chain) = lose unbanked: identical to Farkle rule. - multiplierStep (hot dice equivalent): similar to Farkle hot dice house rule. DOES_NOT_RESEMBLE_FARKLE: Spatial board, tile types, blockers, bombs — all beyond Farkle.
SKYDOM_RESEMBLANCE (MEDIUM): - SixPoolManager pre-shuffled pool with equal face distribution: closely matches Skydom's "pouch" mechanic (draws without replacement, guaranteed equal distribution). - Tile gravity and refill from top: standard Skydom-style cascade. DOES_NOT_RESEMBLE_SKYDOM: Scoring is Farkle-derived (not match-N colored gems), energy gate system, bomb trigger via combo not spatial match.
BUGGIN_RESEMBLANCE (LOW-MEDIUM): - Ghost tile drift mechanic: loose resemblance to creature movement in Buggin. - No creature system: primary Buggin distinction (creature abilities, movement AI) is entirely absent. - Disruption events (ice_send, lock_send): resembles Buggin's bug-to-opponent mechanic. DOES_NOT_RESEMBLE_BUGGIN: No creature types, no creature AI, no creature kill scoring, no creature-specific abilities.
NOT_RESEMBLING_ANY_CITED_GAME: - CSPRNG commit-reveal fairness chain: unique to casino sweepstakes compliance. - Energy gate (NORMAL/PRIME/FRENZY): custom. - 20 genre composability layer: custom. - HEIST vault mechanic: custom. - RALLY role system: custom. - Provable fairness + sweepstakes compliance: unique requirement.
Q.RISK: LOW — comparison is conceptual, not code-derived. Confidence reduced because Buggin game design doc was not read.
Q.MISSING: Buggin game design document if it exists in this repository.

Q.QUESTION: What systems conflict with the vision: Paradox Pay. Explain each conflict.
Q.R:
PARADOX_PAY_INFERRED_VISION: Skill-reads-board → informed risk → PDX sweepstakes payout → verifiable fairness. Players pay attention to opportunities, not luck. The "paradox" is skill+luck coexisting with provable fairness.
CONFLICT_01: Static spawn weights (F1:47-49) VISION: Spawns should respond to board state to create opportunities (maximize skill expression). CONFLICT: SPAWN_WEIGHTS are fixed constants. spawnTiles has zero board state awareness. Dead boards refill randomly — not shaped to create chains. Luck dominates over skill in refill phase. SEVERITY: HIGH. Directly undermines "skill informs risk" thesis. RESOLUTION: OWC (F15, ADR-021 pending Human approval).
CONFLICT_02: Wild face resolution is automatic (F3:492-513) VISION: Player should be able to exercise skill in resolving wilds (which face to assign). CONFLICT: _resolveWilds() exhaustively picks optimal — player has no input. Reduces skill expression for wild-heavy chains. SEVERITY: MEDIUM. Wild resolution removes a decision moment. RESOLUTION: Optional manual wild assignment UI (player can accept auto or choose face). Low-complexity addition.
CONFLICT_03: Ghost tile (F1:27, F16:C-tier 0.42) VISION: Every tile on board should create decisions and skill expression. CONFLICT: Ghost mechanic (ignore column constraint, drift, anchor) has near-zero strategic surface. Creates confusion, not skill. COMPONENT_AUDIT lowest score. SEVERITY: MEDIUM. Dilutes board reading with mechanic players cannot internalize. RESOLUTION: Redesign to Echo tile (scores as 1-face die, doubles chain score if chained last).
CONFLICT_04: DRAFT phase unimplemented VISION: Facet system (Roguelike) adds draft-round meta-decisions between rounds. CONFLICT: newmodespec.md specifies DRAFT as phase 1 of every round. gameRoom.ts does not emit DRAFT phase — not wired. Players miss the primary meta-decision system. SEVERITY: HIGH. Genre system (20 genres) largely inaccessible without DRAFT. RESOLUTION: Implement DRAFT message type in gameRoom.ts and wire facet draft to client.
CONFLICT_05: Catalyst wild boost wiring gap (F1:76-77, W03 in Q8) VISION: Catalyst tiles enable long-game board shaping — strategic investment. CONFLICT: CATALYST_WILD_BOOST and CATALYST_MAX_BOOST defined in types.ts but not applied in spawnTiles. Player commits catalyst tiles with no effect. Mechanic is dead. SEVERITY: MEDIUM. Breaks strategic promise of catalyst tile.
CONFLICT_06: No lobby classArchetype selection (F7:110-111) VISION: 4 RPG classes with asymmetric skill profiles (PALADIN low-variance, ROGUE high-variance, BARD mid, ARTIFICER mid+build). Player chooses identity. CONFLICT: classArchetype defaults to 'Paladin' in addPlayer(). No JOIN_ROOM field for class. All players are de facto Paladins regardless of class preference. SEVERITY: MEDIUM. Class system inaccessible at lobby — key Paradox Pay identity mechanic.
Q.RISK: MEDIUM — DRAFT status (wired vs not) needs line-level confirmation in gameRoom.ts beyond line 100.
Q.MISSING: - gameRoom.ts DRAFT/FACET message handling (lines 250+). - Catalyst commit handler in processChain.

Q.QUESTION: Define every value system currently present. Score, Currency, Progression, Social, Team, Reputation, Other. Explain interactions.
Q.R:
SCORE: banked: int, per-player, authoritative (profile.banked in RoomPlayer, F7:107). Persists through session. unbanked: int, current-turn risk. Lost on Farkle. Auto-banked if chain lt 6 or turn timer expires. multiplierStep: 0-5 index → MULTIPLIER_LADDER[step] (1.0, 1.25, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0). Applied as Q×multiplierQ/1000. farklePool: communal. Accumulated from all players' farkled unbanked. displayonly per design. vaultTotal: HEIST only. 70% of all banked goes to vault (HEIST_CONSTANTS.VAULT_SPLIT=0.70). rallyPot: RALLY only. Running total of all banks; split evenly at session end.
CURRENCY: FD (Fun Dollars): FD_HAS_MONETARY_VALUE=false. Starter balance=1000 (DEFAULT_WALLET). Used for FD_WAGER/FD_AWARD cycles. PDX: PDX_USD_RATE=1 (1:1 USD). DAILY_PDX_BONUS=10. pdxPlaythroughRequired=100 (PDX_PLAYTHROUGH_RATE=10 means 10× playthrough before redemption). HollaEx on-ramp planned. TransactionTypes: FD_PURCHASE, PDX_GIFT, FD_WAGER, PDX_WAGER, FD_AWARD, PDX_AWARD, PDX_DAILY_BONUS, PDX_REDEEM, PDX_PROMO. FD_TO_PDX_GIFT_RATE=0.01 (100 FD → 1 PDX via gift mechanic, not purchase).
PROGRESSION: multiplierStep: within-session ladder. Resets on Farkle or lt 6 chain bank. anteSchedule: PRE_GAME (required, 10% of stake) + optional MILESTONE antes at score thresholds. RALLY: MILESTONE_2 at 25k (5%). HEIST: MILESTONE_1 at 10k (5%), MILESTONE_3 at 50k (5%). RALLY_MILESTONES: [10k×0.5, 25k×1.0, 50k×2.0, 100k×5.0]. Payout multipliers. classArchetype: PALADIN/ROGUE/BARD/ARTIFICER. Per-match identity. Currently defaults to Paladin. Facets (Roguelike DRAFT): per-round modifier that mutates after 3 rounds. NOT wired (see Q14:CONFLICT_04). Shards (Abstract): temporary scoring rules, 30s duration. Imported in F7:73 but DRAFT not wired.
SOCIAL: DisruptionEvent: {ice_send, lock_send, scramble}. Send blockers or scramble opponent grid. Targets: targetColumns[]. ReactionVote: UP/DOWN/null per player. Lightweight signal. ChatMessage: encrypted (encryptedContent + iv). End-to-end. UserProfile.asciiArt: identity expression. UserProfile.color: 6 options (red/orange/yellow/green/blue/purple).
TEAM: RALLY: rallyPot shared equally at session end. Roles (RAINMAKER, HEADHUNTER, ARCHIVIST, CONDUCTOR) affect individual contribution. HEIST: vault (70% accumulation) distributed on heist success. Block window creates team conflict. ARCHIVIST_PCT=0.15 — Archivist receives 15% of team pot.
REPUTATION: NO formal reputation system. UserProfile tracks username, color, asciiArt. No win rate, rank, ELO, or reputation score in types.ts. getSkillDifferentialReport() compares top-10% vs bottom-50% for regulatory evidence only — not player-facing.
INTERACTIONS: score × currency: endSession() computes payout = f(banked, stakeAmount, netRTP). Score → PDX/FD payout. score × progression: multiplierStep amplifies scaledScore. Higher ladder = higher payout potential = higher Farkle risk. currency × social: DisruptionEvent triggered by PDX wager? NOT confirmed — disruption trigger mechanism not found in read code. team × currency: RALLY/HEIST pot is sum of all player antes + stakes; split per mode formula. team × score: RALLY rallyPot accumulates all individual banks. Individual score irrelevant to final payout.
Q.RISK: LOW — value systems clearly enumerated in types.ts. Interaction completeness at MEDIUM confidence.
Q.MISSING: DisruptionEvent trigger mechanism (what causes ice_send/lock_send/scramble). HollaEx PDX on-ramp (design only).

Q.QUESTION: Can multiple value systems compete simultaneously? If not, what architecture changes are required?
Q.R:
CURRENTLY_SIMULTANEOUS: - score (banked+unbanked) AND multiplierStep: YES — always active together. - FD balance AND PDX balance: YES — both maintained in PlayerWallet simultaneously. - Individual score AND team pot (RALLY/HEIST): YES — per-player banked tracked + rallyPot/vaultTotal separately. - Energy gate AND multiplier ladder: YES — energy determines spawn mode while multiplier ladder applies to scoring. - Ante obligations AND game scoring: YES — antes paid at PRE_GAME and MILESTONE thresholds during play.
NOT_SIMULTANEOUSLY_COMPETITIVE: - FD wager AND PDX wager: EXCLUSIVE per session (currencyMode in LobbySettings — 'FD' OR 'PDX'). Cannot wager both. - classArchetype abilities AND facet modifiers: UNCONFIRMED — both specified in F8 but DRAFT not wired (Q14). - Individual progression AND team reputation: reputation system absent.
ARCHITECTURE_GAPS_FOR_FULL_COMPETITION: A1: Cross-currency competition — FD and PDX in same match. Requires stakeAmount to support split contributions. Currently LobbySettings.currencyMode is single-valued. A2: Reputation competing with score — no reputation system. Would require per-player ELO or standing tracked across sessions in Supabase. A3: Social sacrifice competing with score — DisruptionEvent trigger mechanism unconfirmed. If disruptions are free (no cost), they don't create genuine sacrifice. A4: Genre modifier stack competing with Sacred Core multiplier — anti-stacking rules (F8:281-291) set ceiling at 4.0× combined. Architecture exists; DRAFT wiring required.
Q.RISK: MEDIUM — currencyMode=exclusive prevents FD/PDX simultaneous wager. Not necessarily a design conflict but limits mixed-stake scenarios.
Q.MISSING: DisruptionEvent cost mechanism. DRAFT wiring status (gameRoom.ts lines 250+).

Q.QUESTION: Which mechanics currently reward: immediate gratification, delayed gratification, strategic sacrifice, social sacrifice, future opportunity. Rank effectiveness.
Q.R:
IMMEDIATE_GRATIFICATION (feedback within 500ms): RANK1: scoreFarkle → CHAIN_RESULT with scaledScore. Instant. Visual popups. RANK2: Bomb blast → ptsEarned display + board clear animation. Instant. RANK3: AUTO-BANK on chain lt 6 → banked counter increments. RANK4: Sphere tap → +8 energy. Instant energy bar update. RANK5: multiplier_orb tap → ×1.5 for next chain. Instant activation. EFFECTIVENESS: HIGH. Core game loop feedback is tight and clear.
DELAYED_GRATIFICATION (outcome dependent on future turns): RANK1: MULTIPLIER_LADDER advancement via 6-chains. Each step requires consecutive 6-chain. Ceiling ×4.0. Payoff session-spanning. RANK2: RALLY_MILESTONES at [10k,25k,50k,100k]. Team-accumulated score threshold payoffs. RANK3: HEIST vault accumulation → heist payout. 70% of banks accumulate; payout at threshold. RANK4: Catalyst wild boost (if wired) — accumulated across chains, manifests as higher wild spawn rate. RANK5: Facet mutation after 3 rounds (if DRAFT wired) — compound modifier evolution. EFFECTIVENESS: MEDIUM. Multiplier ladder is effective. Milestones and heist are well-designed. Catalyst/facet effectiveness LOW due to implementation gaps.
STRATEGIC_SACRIFICE (spend now to gain later): RANK1: HEIST initiation — spend 50 energy to trigger vault heist. Risk of block. RANK2: Stealth Pocket — sacrifice chain slot to stash die. Spend now, deploy later. RANK3: ARCHIVIST role (15% tax) — player sacrifices personal score for team multiplier. RANK4: Combo Breaker token use — spend token to reverse Farkle. One-shot per supply. EFFECTIVENESS: MEDIUM. Heist is well-designed. Pocket and Archivist require DRAFT/role system to be wired.
SOCIAL_SACRIFICE (give up personal for social outcome): RANK1: ARCHIVIST 15% tax: genuine personal loss for team benefit. RANK2: DisruptionEvent (if costed): sacrifice resources to attack opponents. RANK3: RALLY role selection: choosing non-optimal role for team composition. EFFECTIVENESS: LOW-MEDIUM. ARCHIVIST works. Disruption effectiveness unknown.
FUTURE_OPPORTUNITY (actions that create later possibilities): RANK1: Catalyst committed → higher wild spawn rate (future chains score more safely). RANK2: Stone damage via adjacency → clearing stone opens board paths. RANK3: Ice thaw positioning — plan adjacent chain to thaw desired face. RANK4: Build-a-Die shard investment (if wired) — 6 shards → custom 7th face. EFFECTIVENESS: LOW-MEDIUM due to wiring gaps. Catalyst, DRAFT, Sandbox not confirmed wired.
Q.RISK: LOW — rankings are design judgments, not behavioral data.
Q.MISSING: Empirical session analytics showing which mechanics players engage with most. PostHog level_complete events exist but chain-level data only in casino mode.

Q.QUESTION: What is the current RTP model? Exact implementation. Dependencies. Risk areas.
Q.R:
RTP_CONFIG_TABLE (F4:27-36): SOLO_FREE: targetRTP=0.92, grossRTP=0.92, netRTP=0.92, poolSize=60, margin=0.00. SOLO_CASINO: targetRTP=0.92, grossRTP=0.92, netRTP=0.92, poolSize=60, margin=0.00. VS_FREE: targetRTP=1.00, grossRTP=1.00, netRTP=1.00, poolSize=66, margin=0.00. VS_CASINO: targetRTP=0.92, grossRTP=1.00, netRTP=0.92, poolSize=66, margin=0.08. RALLY_FREE: targetRTP=0.92, grossRTP=0.92, netRTP=0.92, poolSize=66, margin=0.00. RALLY_CASINO: targetRTP=0.92, grossRTP=1.00, netRTP=0.92, poolSize=66, margin=0.08. HEIST_FREE: targetRTP=0.92, grossRTP=0.92, netRTP=0.92, poolSize=66, margin=0.08. HEIST_CASINO: targetRTP=0.92, grossRTP=1.00, netRTP=0.92, poolSize=66, margin=0.08. NOTE: ADR-010 calibration PROPOSE ONLY (pending Human approval since T6). rtpConfig.ts is Sacred (S4). These values are immutable without Human authorization.
PAYOUT_FORMULAS (F7:34-39): SOLO_CASINO: payout = (playerBanked / levelWinScore) × stakeAmount × targetRTP. VS_CASINO: highestBanked wins totalPot × targetRTP. RALLY_CASINO: highestBanked wins totalPot × targetRTP. HEIST_CASINO: highestBanked wins totalPot × targetRTP. NOTE: RALLY formula in gameRoom.ts comment says winner-takes-all, but monteCarlo.ts and newmodespec.md describe equal split. CONTRADICTION — F7:34-39 may be stale comments.
MONTE_CARLO_VALIDATION (F5): calibrateNormalizer: 4000 sessions, greedy-optimal play (bestSubsetScore), seededRng(i). runFullAuditHarness: 10000 sessions, ±0.02 deviance threshold. All 8 modes. skillJitter: ±5% max perturbation around theoretical RTP (avgScore=3500 empirical baseline, F5:215). Test result (session-13.json): 3/3 PASS via rtp.harness.test.ts.
FIXED_POINT_COMPLIANCE: scoreFarkle: multiplierQ=Q×1000. scaledScore=Math.round(score×multiplierQ/1000). No floats in scoring path. MULTIPLIER_LADDER: [1.0, 1.25, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0] — stored as JS numbers. Multiplication via Math.round preserves integer output. CSPRNG: uint32/0xffffffff → float for RNG draws. Not in scoring path.
DEPENDENCIES: F2 (scoreFarkle) → scoring output → payout calculation. F6 (CSPRNG/seededRng) → RNG sequence → pool draws. F3 (SixPoolManager) → face distribution → scoring opportunity distribution. F5 (monteCarlo) → audit validation. F21 (playIntegrity) → geofence → access control. F22 (ComplianceService) → PDX eligibility → payout gate.
RISK_AREAS: R1: ADR-010 pending — 0.92 netRTP not Monte Carlo validated for all modes. Risk that realized RTP deviates outside ±2% in production. R2: RALLY payout formula contradiction (winner-takes-all in gameRoom comments vs equal-split in monteCarlo). If implemented as winner-takes-all, RALLY RTP is highly sensitive to skill differential. R3: createGrid uses seedNum=Date.now() (not CSPRNG) — board layout not covered by commit-reveal fairness proof. Risk if regulators require full board provability. R4: skillJitter in monteCarlo is ±5% max synthetic perturbation — empirical basis (avgScore=3500) is hardcoded, not derived from real session data.
Q.RISK: HIGH — RALLY payout formula contradiction could mean production game pays differently than audited. R3 (Date.now grid seed) is a provable fairness gap.
Q.MISSING: - RALLY payout implementation in gameRoom.ts endSession() (lines 250+). - Whether createGrid seedNum has been moved to CSPRNG-derived value post T9.

Q.QUESTION: What systems could be safely modified without affecting: RTP, scoring, fairness, compliance, sacred files.
Q.R:
SAFE_MODIFICATIONS (confirmed no RTP/scoring/fairness/sacred impact):
SM01: SPAWN_WEIGHTS (F1:47-49) CONFIRMED NOT SACRED per OWC design (F15): SPAWN_WEIGHTS in farkle-shared/src/types.ts are modifiable. IMPACT: Changes tile density distribution. Does NOT affect scoring (scoreFarkle operates on presented faces only). Does NOT affect RTP (RTP is a payout formula, not a spawn formula). DOES require monteCarlo re-run if face-1/face-5 weights change significantly. OWC_CONSTRAINT: Any modification must keep face distribution balanced across pool (SixPoolManager perFace=equal). OWC adjusts wild threshold, not die face weights.
